briefing:
أهلاً بك. بصفتي المدير الفني الأعلى كفاءة لفريقك، أقدم لك التحليل التكتيكي الشامل للجولة رقم 11، والمصمم وفق أقصى درجات الدقة الإحصائية والبرمجة الرياضية ومحرك "القواعد الذهبية".

---

### 1. التكتيك المعتمد وموقف الترتيب (AGGRESSIVE Mode)
نحن نعمل حالياً ضمن استراتيجية **الهجوم التعويضي (AGGRESSIVE)** للارتقاء من الترتيب الحالي (10,733,399). الترتيب المتأخر لا يتطلب التهور، بل يتطلب "الجرأة المحسوبة" واستغلال عناصر الـ Differentials ذات السقف العالي. اعتمدنا تشكيل (4-4-2) متوازن هجومياً، مع الحفاظ على مرونة مالية استثنائية ورصيد متبقٍ يبلغ **£14.2m**، مما يمنحنا قوة تحرك هائلة للجولات القادمة.

---

### 2. مدى مطابقة القرارات للقواعد الذهبية (Gold Rules Compliance)
تم صياغة قرارات هذه الجولة لتطابق القواعد التاريخية المثبتة بدقة:
* **قاعدة التبديلات واقتناص الـ Hits:** تثبت القواعد الذهبية أن التبديلات الفعالة تحقق متوسط 13.4 نقطة في الجولة الأولى مقابل 2.6 نقطة للاعب المباع (صافي ربح +10.8 نقطة). أخذ خصم (-4 نقاط) في هذه الجولة يتماشى مع القاعدة التاريخية التي شرعنت أخذ الـ Hits لاقتناص السقف الانفجاري، حيث نحقق قفزة فورية في النقاط المتوقعة (xP) بزيادة قدرها **+3.1 xP** في الجولة الحالية فقط، مما يغطي تكلفة السالب ويضمن أرباحاً تراكمية.
* **قاعدة كفاءة الأسعار (Price Efficiency):** تنص القاعدة على أن اللاعبين الأقل من £6.0m يقدمون أعلى معدل نقاط مقابل السعر (2.69 pts/£m). التعاقد مع **Rudoni (£4.9m)** يمثل تطبيقاً حرفياً لهذه القاعدة.
* **قاعدة شارة القيادة (Captain Cost Rule):** تشير البيانات التاريخية إلى أن متوسط سعر الكابتن المثالي هو £6.5m (وأن الأصول ذات السعر >=£9.5m تم تكبيتنها في 20% فقط من الجولات). اختيار **N.Jackson (AVL)** ينسجم تماماً مع هذه القاعدة باستهداف لاعب محوري بسعر متوسط وسقف نقاط مرتفع.

---

### 3. التحليل الرياضي والتكتيكي للتبديلات وتبرير الـ Hit (-4)
* **🔴 بيع Mbeumo (xP: 3.8) ──► 🟢 شراء Rudoni (xP: 5.4 | السعر: £4.9m):**
  تراجع مردود Mbeumo المتوقع (3.8 xP)، بينما يتمتع Rudoni بجدول رائع على المدى القصير [CRY (H), LEE (A), IPS (H)] مع فارق xP إيجابي ملموس وقدرة عالية على تحقيق النقاط مقارنة بسعره المنخفض.
* **🔴 بيع Isak (xP: 5.8) ──► 🟢 شراء Evanilson (xP: 7.3 | السعر: £6.5m):**
  بيع Isak جاء اعادةً لتوجيه الاستثمار نحو مهاجم يمر بفترة فورمة وأرقام متوقعة أعلى (7.3 xP) ومباريات ممتازة [NFO (H), FUL (A), BHA (H)].
* **جدوى الـ Hit (-4) على مدى 3 جولات:**
  الفرق الفوري في الجولة 11 هو **+3.1 xP** (من 9.6 إلى 12.7 للبدلاء). وعلى مدار الجولات الثلاث القادمة، من المتوقع أن يجمع البديلان ما يقارب **36.5 نقطة متوقعة** مقابل **23.0 نقطة** للاعبين المباعين، مما يعطي صافي ربح تكتيكي يتجاوز **+9.5 نقطة** بعد خصم نقاط الـ Hit، وهو عائد استثماري ممتاز يبرر القرار تماماً.

---

### 4. مبررات شارة القيادة (C) والنائب (VC)
* **الكابتن (C): N.Jackson (xP: 7.0)**
  يقود الهجوم بأعلى نسبة نقاط متوقعة في الفريق (7.0 xP)، مستفيداً من مواجهة إيجابية ومعدل تحول فرص عالٍ. يتماشى الاختيار مع القاعدة الذهبية التي تفضل الكباتن من الفئة المتوسطة ذات القدرة الانفجارية.
* **النائب (VC): Manzambi (xP: 6.7)**
  تم اختياره كخيار تفاضلي ممتاز (Differential) يمتلك ثاني أعلى xP في التشكيلة، ليؤمن شارة القيادة في حال حدوث أي غياب طارئ.

---

### 5. استراتيجية الخواص وحماية ميزانية الفريق
* **إدارة الخواص:** التوصية الحاسمة هي **الاحتفاظ بجميع الخواص المتاحة** (Wildcard x2, Free Hit x1, Triple Captain x1, Bench Boost x1). لا يوجد داعٍ لاستخدام أي خاصية في جولة عادية، وسنقوم بادخارها للجولات المزدوجة والمقاطعة (DGW/BGW) لتحقيق أعلى عائد ممكن.
* **إدارة الميزانية:** السيولة المالية المتوفرة (**£14.2m في البنك**) تمنحنا درعاً استراتيجياً وقدرة على جلب أي لاعب سوبر-بريميوم في الجولات القادمة بضغطة زر واحدة ودون الحاجة لتفكيك الفريق.

---

### الخلاصة التنفيذية
إن التعديلات التكتيكية للجولة 11 مدعومة بالكامل بالأرقام وقواعد المحرك التاريخي؛ حيث استبدلنا عناصر متراجعة بأخرى ذات xP أعلى وجدول أفضل، واعتمدنا شارة قيادة منطقية وفقاً لقاعدة القيمة الاستثمارية، مع تحمل (-4 نقاط) مبررة رياضياً بفرق نقاط متوقع يتجاوز التكلفة بسرعة. الفريق الآن جاهز تماماً للانطلاق لتحقيق قفزة نوعية في الترتيب العام.

press_wire.title: Dewsbury-Hall On What 'Top Week' Can Do For Everton
press_wire.summary: Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall spoke to evertontv after the Blues' satisfying come-from-behind victory over Coventry City on Friday night. The Toffees fell behind shortly after the half-time interval at Hill Dickinson Stadium, before a brace from Thierno Barry and a well-taken strike by Dewsbury-Hall sealed a third consecutive win in the space of eight days. Watch Dewsbury-Hall's full interview below to hear him reflect on a busy week, the character inside the Everton changing room, his appreciation for the support shown by Evertonians, England hopes and why he is optimistic for the future.

press_wire.title: Buendía expecting difficult game against United
press_wire.summary: Fixtures Manchester United Vs. Aston Villa - Sun, Nov 08 2026, 16:30 Emi Buendía is expecting a difficult match at Old Trafford on Sunday, when Aston Villa lock horns with Manchester United (ko 4.30pm). Michael Carrick’s side are enduring a difficult run of form in the league, winning just one of their nine matches thus far. Despite this, Buendía believes United’s qualities and threats are still clear to see, and feels Sunday’s hosts will be buoyed by a thrilling comeback victory at home to Roma in the UEFA Champions League in midweek. “It’s another very difficult match,” the Argentine said. “The last years, we didn’t win there in the league. My first season, I think we won there, so it’s a very difficult place to go. “Obviously, a great team, great players. They’re not in their best moment, but their qualities are there. “They are a top club. They had that momentum in the Champions League this week, having a comeback in a difficult match against Roma. “They will try to get this momentum to get a victory in the Premier League, so we have to go there and try to be strong and try to fight with our style, with our football, to try to win away.” After a tricky start to the campaign from Villa’s point of view, Buendía has been enthused by his side’s upturn in league form of late. The Villans are unbeaten in their last five Premier League outings – taking 11 points from a possible 15 – but the attacking midfielder believes the best is still to come from Unai Emery’s men. The 29-year-old added: “We didn’t have a great start. We didn’t get good results in the beginning. “Then, just before the last [international] break, we started to get good results – I think a good feeling also as a team. “Recently, we were playing better, we kept getting good results. We were back to winning – an amazing match at home against Man City, what we needed. “But we’re still finding our best rhythm, I think, our best football. We are working on it every week, but this league is so difficult, so now you can beat any team, and you can be defeated by any team. “We have to prepare every match 100%, and we are really looking forward [to] this weekend.”

press_wire.title: NOTTINGHAM FOREST REMEMBERS
press_wire.summary: As the football community comes together this weekend to observe Remembrance, Nottingham Forest is immensely proud to welcome inspiring members of our Forest Forces community to the City Ground. This weekend offers a powerful moment to reflect, honour, and show our deep gratitude to the service personnel and veterans who have dedicated their lives to defending others. Representing our club with distinction on Saturday, our dedicated Remembrance Guard and Wreath Layers - alongside our bugler, embody the very best of courage, resilience, and community spirit. Among those stepping onto the pitch is Sean Severn, a Warrant Officer (WO1) Air Loadmaster Master Aircrew serving at RAF Brize Norton, who will be attending his first match in uniform as both a serving member of HM Forces and a proud local fan. Joining him is Jack Reacher, a Flight Sergeant with over 16 years of service who shares a deep generational bond with the Reds through his grandfather, a former Director and Chairman of Nottingham Forest. Our guard and wreath layers represent a remarkable tapestry of military heritage - from seasoned veterans of the Worcestershire and Sherwood Foresters and The Rifles to Royal Navy personnel, RAF medics, and those who have served on operations across the globe. Guiding us through our pre-match moment of reflection will be Paul Cuthbert, our bugler. A lifelong Forest fan and veteran member of the Salvation Army who has played the cornet since the age of five, Paul will sound the tribute before kick-off, joined by family and community as we observe a collective silence. As we stand side by side with Forest Forces this weekend, we reaffirm our unwavering commitment to those who have served and their families. We will remember them. Meet the Veterans Nottingham Forest proudly pays tribute to the brave service personnel, veterans, and military families of our Forest Forces community. From those currently serving on operational duties around the globe to veteran supporters, we honour your sacrifices. The Remembrance Guard Honouring those standing proud on the pitch. Aron Fowler: Served for 10 years in the Worcestershire and Sherwood Foresters Regiment until injured in Afghanistan in 2007. Ben Howes: 13 years in the Army (2nd Battalion, The Rifles), Royal Army Veterinary Corps dog handler, and close combat section commander. David Peacock: Served in Germany and Northern Ireland; involved with the 13th Army Youth Team and Army Cadets. Jane Ferreira: RAMC physiotherapy officer (2007–2019), serving at Headley Court and Stanford Hall, with an operational tour to Afghanistan. Keith Straw: Joined the Grenadier Guards at 15 as a Junior Soldier, serving in Hong Kong, Brunei, and public duties. Lee Blunt: Served across regular forces (The Queen’s Royal Lancers) and reserves (Army Intelligence in Bosnia), with deployments in Germany, Iraq, and Canada. Maggie Cassidy: Joined PMRAFNS in 1978, training as an enrolled nurse at Ely and later serving as a mental health nurse. Matthew Bailey: Petty Officer Air Engineering Technician serving at RAF Marham, 14 years in the Royal Navy, and a lifelong Forest fan. Michael Staples: Served from 1979 to 1993, completing multiple tours of Northern Ireland, Cyprus, and various global postings. Paul Grimbley: NATO ORF, Arctic Warfare, and Desert Warfare trained Close Reconnaissance Regiment veteran, lifelong Forest fan since 1974. The Wreath Layers Sean Severn: Born in Hucknall, Sean is in his final year of an incredible 42-year RAF career. A Master Aircrew (WO1) Air Loadmaster at RAF Brize Norton, he has flown on Wessex, Chinook, and Hercules aircraft across almost every major operational deployment. Awarded the Meritorious Service Medal in the 2023 King’s Birthday Honours and Chairman of his local RBL branch, the lifelong Reds fan is proud to attend his first Forest game in full uniform. Jack Reacher: Flight Sergeant Jack Reacher has served over 16 years in the RAF across leadership and operational roles, deploying to Afghanistan, Libya, Iraq, Cyprus, and the Falklands. Jack’s Forest roots run deep: his grandfather, Fred, was a former Club Chairman and Director. A lifelong supporter, Jack’s childhood memories include running out as a mascot alongside legend Stuart Pearce. Bugler Paul Cuthbert: Born and bred in Nottingham, retired and married to Hillary, Paul has been a member of the Salvation Army band his entire life - learning to play the cornet at just five years old! A passionate sports fan and regular runner, Paul is honoured to participate in the Remembrance ceremony before kick-off.

press_wire.summary: Half Price Drinks Pints from £3.30 Forest v Manchester City Fans heading to the City Ground this afternoon can take advantage of a special Early Bird Matchday Offer. All draught alcohol and hot drinks purchased within the City Ground Fan Zone and Trentside Lounge will be half price for one hour, from opening at 15:00 up until 16:00. In addition, when turnstiles open at 16:00, draught alcohol and hot drinks will be half price across all home general admission concourses until 16:45.
